basis: getInfo default messages; stable definition with current module resolver

stable.setBuildOrigin: set build origin (x, y, z) to [X],  0,  [Z]
stable.setBuildMode: set build mode to [MODE] (TRACE delay [TRACE_DELAY] seconds)
stable.flushBuildCommands: wait for sent block placements to finish
stable.setBlock: set block at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] to ID [BLOCK] state [STATE]
stable.setBlocks: set blocks from x :[X1]  y :[Y1]  z :[Z1] to x :[X2]  y :[Y2]  z :[Z2] as ID [BLOCK] state [STATE]
stable.getBlock: block information at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z]
stable.getBlocks: put block information from x :[X1]  y :[Y1]  z :[Z1] to x :[X2]  y :[Y2]  z :[Z2] in [LIST]
stable.getHeightBelow: ground height at x :[X]  z :[Z] at or below y :[MAX_Y]
stable.getSign: sign information at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z]
stable.setSign: set sign [FACE] at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] to [LINE0] [LINE1] [LINE2] [LINE3]
stable.updateSignLine: set sign [FACE] line [LINE] at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] to [TEXT]
stable.spawnParticle: spawn particle [PARTICLE] at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] offset x[OFFSET_X]  y[OFFSET_Y]  z[OFFSET_Z] speed:[SPEED] count:[COUNT] visibility:[FORCE]
stable.spawnEntity: spawn entity [ENTITY] at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] and put its handle in [VARIABLE]
stable.getNearbyEntities: put entities near x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] radius [RADIUS] limit [MAX_ENTITIES] in [LIST]
stable.setEntityPose: move entity [HANDLE] to [DIMENSION] x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] yaw:[YAW] pitch:[PITCH]
stable.dustParticleSpec: dust particle red [RED] green [GREEN] blue [BLUE] size [SIZE] for [RECEIVER]
stable.setPlayerDirection: set player direction to x[X]  y[Y]  z[Z]
stable.setEntityDirection: set direction of entity [HANDLE] to x[X]  y[Y]  z[Z]
stable.playSound: play sound [SOUND] at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] options [OPTIONS]
stable.playBlockSound: play [KIND] sound of block at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] options [OPTIONS]
stable.soundOptions: sound options volume [VOLUME] pitch or note [HEIGHT] receiver [RECEIVER]
stable.strikeLightning: strike lightning at x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z]
stable.whenPickaxePoke: when a block is poked with a pickaxe
stable.setPlayerPos: move player to [DIMENSION] x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z]
stable.setPlayerPose: move player to [DIMENSION] x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z] yaw:[YAW] pitch:[PITCH]
stable.setPlayerXYZ: move player to x :[X]  y :[Y]  z :[Z]
